speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Keep with me. The aisle is full of people who would like a word, and I am not giving them one.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: If a neighbour asks how thou kept the lesson, thou kept it. That is the whole answer. I will not have a recital at the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I kept it. I have no recital. The street is where we are going, and the street is short.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Dinner is at the Cross. Smile if thou must, and do not stop to be thanked for coming home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not stopping. The pew is behind us.
